cues.en: Welcome to the tools section of this course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這門課的工具章節。

cues.en: So, in this example, we're going to make some tools and going to try and use them against an agent.
cues.zh: 這個範例會建立幾個工具，並試著讓代理程式使用它們。

cues.en: So, you can make both informational tools and action tools.
cues.zh: 工具分成資訊型工具，以及執行動作的工具。

cues.en: And in this case, I have made some tools down here.
cues.zh: 這裡我先在下面寫好幾個工具。

cues.en: In terms of, I have a person info record here with just name and favourite colour of people.
cues.zh: 有一個 PersonInfo record，只存放姓名和喜歡的顏色。

cues.en: And I made a few tools that can work with them.
cues.zh: 再建立幾個可以操作這些資料的方法。

cues.en: I have a set of data here with just some names and some favourite colours.
cues.zh: 這裡有一組資料，只有幾個人名和他們喜歡的顏色。

cues.en: And then I exposed two tools.
cues.zh: 接著提供兩個工具。

cues.en: I exposed a get persons, and I've just put in so we can see that when they are called.
cues.zh: 第一個是 GetPersons，我加上輸出，方便看到它何時被呼叫。

cues.en: And I get a person by name.
cues.zh: 另一個是依照姓名取得某個人。

cues.en: This is just a C# class.
cues.zh: 這其實只是一般的 C# 類別，

cues.en: It has nothing to do with AI or tools or anything.
cues.zh: 和 AI、工具或其他東西都沒有直接關係。

cues.en: But it's just a class, and we are going to turn this into a tool.
cues.zh: 它就是一個類別，接下來才把它轉成工具。

cues.en: In the same manner, we just have a small static class down here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，下面還有一個小型的靜態類別，

cues.en: That's called change colour of the console.
cues.zh: 用來改變主控台的文字顏色。

cues.en: And again, we are calling so we can see what happens.
cues.zh: 一樣加入輸出，好讓我們觀察發生了什麼。

cues.en: So, this is how we define our tools.
cues.zh: 工具就是這樣定義，

cues.en: Just plain C# code.
cues.zh: 使用一般的 C# 程式碼即可。

cues.en: In this case, it's something that just works here in memory.
cues.zh: 這個例子只是操作記憶體裡的資料，

cues.en: But it could easily have gone out to a hard drive.
cues.zh: 但也可以改成存取硬碟，

cues.en: It could have gone into another API.
cues.zh: 或呼叫其他 API。

cues.en: The action could have been to place an order in a system or whatever you want.
cues.zh: 動作也可以是到某個系統建立訂單，或任何你想做的事情。

cues.en: It's just C#, and it can be pretty much anything.
cues.zh: 它就是 C#，幾乎什麼都能做，

cues.en: And it can take input, and it can take output.
cues.zh: 也可以有輸入和輸出。

cues.en: So, what we're going to do is we're going to make our normal Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 接下來，先建立一般的 Azure OpenAI 用戶端。

cues.en: We are going to new up our tool because we need that a little later on here.
cues.zh: 也建立工具類別的執行個體，因為稍後會用到。

cues.en: And then we're going to make our agent.
cues.zh: 然後建立代理程式。

cues.en: And we have told the agent it knows people, and it can change colours of the console.
cues.zh: 我們告訴代理程式，它知道人員資料，也能改變主控台的顏色。

cues.en: We probably don't need to tell it this.
cues.zh: 這些其實不一定需要另外說明。

cues.en: Sometimes when it's very advanced tools, you might want an instruction to say, when this happened, call this tool, when this happened, call this tool.
cues.zh: 有時工具很複雜，會需要在指示中明確說：「發生這件事時，呼叫這個工具；發生那件事時，呼叫另一個工具。」

cues.en: So, I could, for example, here say change the colours of the console.
cues.zh: 例如這裡可以告訴它，改變主控台顏色時，

cues.en: I could have told that that tool is called change console colour.
cues.zh: 應使用名為 ChangeConsoleColor 的工具。

cues.en: In this case, it's so obvious that we actually don't need it.
cues.zh: 但這個例子已經很清楚，所以不需要額外指定。

cues.en: Then we have our tools.
cues.zh: 接著設定工具集合。

cues.en: And our tools are just something called an AI function factory, where we say create.
cues.zh: 工具是透過 AIFunctionFactory 的 Create 方法建立，

cues.en: And there we give some kind of delegate.
cues.zh: 傳入某種委派。

cues.en: In this case, it's the get person method down here that we are getting.
cues.zh: 這個例子就是下面的 GetPersons 方法。

cues.en: And we're telling it this is the name of the tool.
cues.zh: 同時告訴它工具的名稱。

cues.en: And tools and AIs in general really like this snake case with the underscores.
cues.zh: 工具和 AI 通常偏好使用底線連接的 snake_case 命名。

cues.en: So, we just call it get persons, and we tell here's the description of the tool that it can get all persons you know, you meaning the AI.
cues.zh: 所以命名為 get_persons，描述則寫「取得你所知道的所有人」，這裡的你是指 AI。

cues.en: And get persons, so you get a specific person by name.
cues.zh: 另一個則是依照姓名，取得特定人員的資料。

cues.en: And the final tool is just static methods.
cues.zh: 最後一個工具是靜態方法，

cues.en: So, we're going to use that and say change console colour, and change the colour of the console.
cues.zh: 因此直接提供 ChangeConsoleColor，描述是改變主控台顏色。

cues.en: And beyond that, it's the same chat loop that we have done in the past.
cues.zh: 其他部分則和前面建立的對話迴圈相同。

cues.en: So, let's see this in action on how it works.
cues.zh: 實際看看它如何運作。

cues.en: So, we can ask it a set of questions.
cues.zh: 可以問一連串問題。

cues.en: For example, we could ask, what is John's favourite colour?
cues.zh: 例如「John 最喜歡什麼顏色？」。

cues.en: And it will come back and say John's favourite colour is red.
cues.zh: 它會回答，John 最喜歡紅色。

cues.en: We could then ask it, who have blue as their favourite colour?
cues.zh: 接著問「誰最喜歡藍色？」。

cues.en: And we saw that up here it called get person because it could do that.
cues.zh: 可以看到上面呼叫了 GetPersons，因為它能透過工具取得資料。

cues.en: And we can set breakpoints in here if we want to and see what's going on.
cues.zh: 如果想看得更清楚，也可以在裡面設中斷點。

cues.en: So, we can do that.
cues.zh: 現在就這樣做，

cues.en: We get a breakpoint.
cues.zh: 讓程式停在中斷點，

cues.en: We call it to get person.
cues.zh: 可以看到它呼叫了取得人員資料的方法。

cues.en: And it tells that Rasmus have blue as their favourite colour, which was down here as well.
cues.zh: 結果顯示 Rasmus 最喜歡藍色，也就是下面這筆資料。

cues.en: So, that is fairly simple to work with information like that.
cues.zh: 這樣操作資訊，其實相當簡單。

cues.en: And we can, in a similar manner, do actions.
cues.zh: 同樣的方式也能執行動作。

cues.en: So, we can say change the colour to green.
cues.zh: 例如說「把顏色改成綠色」。

cues.en: And it will now change the console colour to green because we essentially just ran this piece of code being our action in our case.
cues.zh: 主控台就會變綠色，因為它實際執行了這段程式碼；這就是本例中的動作。

cues.en: But because this is AI, it can also be more advanced than just simple commands like this.
cues.zh: 但因為這是 AI，還能處理比這種簡單指令更進階的需求。

cues.en: So, for example, what we could do is we could go in and say, change the colour of the main colour of the Canadian flag.
cues.zh: 例如說「把顏色改成加拿大國旗的主要顏色」。

cues.en: And now it knew that the Canadian flag is red and white and the main colour is red.
cues.zh: 它知道加拿大國旗是紅白兩色，而主要顏色是紅色，

cues.en: So, it used that information to grab that and run it.
cues.zh: 所以利用這項資訊，選擇顏色並執行。

cues.en: In a similar manner, let me try to restart this just so it's even easier to see what is going on here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，先重新啟動一次，讓過程看起來更清楚。

cues.en: If I go in and say, change the colour of Rasmus to Rasmus' favourite colour, what
cues.zh: 如果說「把顏色改成 Rasmus 最喜歡的顏色」，

cues.en: will happen is it's going to call persons.
cues.zh: 它首先會呼叫取得人員資料的工具。

cues.en: So, it finds all persons.
cues.zh: 先找出所有人員。

cues.en: In this case, it was unsure who Rasmus was, so it didn't dare try to call this, so it's confirming.
cues.zh: 這次它還不確定誰是 Rasmus，所以沒有直接呼叫單一人員查詢，而是先確認。

cues.en: It found me, it found the blue, and then it changed the colour by chaining the two tools together.
cues.zh: 找到我、查到藍色，再把兩個工具串起來，改變主控台顏色。

cues.en: So, it called this tool in order to call this tool after the fact.
cues.zh: 也就是先呼叫這個工具，再依結果呼叫另一個工具。

cues.en: And you can chain tooling a lot of different things.
cues.zh: 工具可以串接成很多不同的操作。

cues.en: So, we could say, change colour to yellow and then green.
cues.zh: 例如說「先改成黃色，再改成綠色」。

cues.en: So, now it called both.
cues.zh: 它就呼叫了兩次工具。

cues.en: We didn't see anything of yellow, but of course, it just follows instructions as it should.
cues.zh: 雖然黃色一閃而過看不太到，但它確實照指示執行。

cues.en: And again, these are just small party tricks here, but it could just as easily have been get the information for order number this and this in this API, get the weather
cues.zh: 這裡只是小型展示，但同樣可以用來向 API 取得某個訂單的資料、查詢

cues.en: for Paris, place this order into the system, because if we don't provide all information, it
cues.zh: 巴黎天氣，或在系統中建立訂單。如果沒有提供完整資訊，

cues.en: is intelligent enough to say, okay, I also need this, this, and this in order to call this tool.
cues.zh: 它也能理解：要呼叫這個工具，我還需要哪些其他資訊。

cues.en: So, tools are very, very powerful.
cues.zh: 所以工具非常強大。

cues.en: You just write some code that would normally be called, and then you create them using these AI function factories.
cues.zh: 只要寫出一般會呼叫的程式碼，再透過 AIFunctionFactory 把它們建立成工具即可。
